QUETTA WATER AND SANITATION AUTHORITY (EMPLOYEE'S SERVICE) REGULATIONS,
2011
QUETTA WATER AND SANITATION
AUTHORITY (EMPLOYEE'S SERVICE) REGULATIONS, 2011
[Gazette of Balochistan,
Extraordinary,
1st October, 2011]
No.Q-WASA/Admin/3/Rules/2011/645-55,
dated 1-10-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred under section 13(1) read
with section 34(2) of the Quetta Water and Sanitation Authority Act, 2004, (Act
No.XII of 2004), the Quetta Water and Sanitation Authority with prior approval
of the Government of Balochistan, is pleased to make the following Regulations,
namely:--
CHAPTER - I
PRELIMINARY
1 Short
title, application and commencement.---(1) These Regulations may be called
"the Quetta Water and Sanitation Authority (Employee's Service)
Regulations 2011".
(2) It
shall apply to all the Employees in the service of the Authority, whose pays
are debitable to the funds of the Authority:
Provided
that the persons employed on contract basis or on deputation with the Authority
or on casual work-charged basis, not anything contrary to the provisions of
these regulation shall be governed by the terms and conditions of their
appointment or deputation or the wages as the case may be.
(3) It
shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---(1)
In these regulations, unless there is anything repugnant to the subject or
context,--
(a) "Act"
means the Quetta Water and Sanitation Authority
Act, 2004, (Act No. XII of 2004);
(b) "Appendix"
means the Appendices appended to these Regulations;
(c) "Appointing
Authority" means the authority competent to make appointment under these
regulations and as specified in column 4 of the Appendix-I against each post;
(d) "Authority"
means the Quetta Water and Sanitation Authority established under section 3 of
the Act;
(e) "Board"
means the Board of the Authority constituted under section 5 of the Act:
(f) "Cadre"
means the strength of service or a part of service sanctioned as a separate
unit;
(g) "Commission"
means the Balochistan Public Service Commission;
(h) "Competent
Authority" means the authority designated either under the Act or by
specified powers;
(i) "Confirmation"
means the declaration of an employee as permanent / regular against a permanent
post;
(j) "Managing
Director" means the Managing Director of the Authority, appointed under
section 8(1)(a) of the Act;
(k) "Duty"
means the period during which an employee performs the duties of post and
includes.
(i) service
as probationer or apprentice, provided that such service is followed by
confirmation; and
(ii) the
period treated as duty by the competent authority.
(l) "Employee"
for the purpose of these Regulations means a person who is employed for salary
or wages by the Authority in any kind of work manual or otherwise in, or in
connection with the work of the Authority and is paid from the Authority's
funds, but does not include casual work-charged staff and persons on deputation
with the Authority or engaged on contract basis;
(m) "Foreign
Service" means service in which an employee receives his pay with the
sanction of the Authority from any source other than the Authority;
(n) "Government"
means the Government of Balochistan;
(o) "Head
of Branch" means any officer whom the Board declares to be the Head of a
branch for the purpose of these Regulations;
(p) "Initial
recruitment" means appointment made otherwise than by promotion or
transfer;
(q) "Joining
time" means the time allowed to an employee to join a new post, or to
travel to or from a station to which he is posted;
(r) "Leave"
means leave which is taken with the approval of the competent Authority:
(s) "Lien"
means title of an employee to hold substantively either, immediately or on the
termination of period or periods of absence, a permanent post, including a
tenure post, to which he has been appointed substantively;
(t) "Officiating
in a post" means performing the duties of a post on which another employee
holds a lien or of a vacant post to which the competent authority appoints

shall be liable to
dismissal from service.
